subject: Re: Pilot credits extension & burn-rate check-in
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lia Chen <lia.chen@acmeanalytics.com>, Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@acmeanalytics.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Feb 2026 15:10:00 -0800
Subject: Follow-up: pilot scope, token volumes & pricing targets

Hi Lia / Tom — thanks again for the call today. Wanted to recap our discussion and confirm next steps so we can get the pilot moving. Key points from the discovery: 

- Workload & token volumes: you expect ~10–20M tokens/month initially, with spike tests up to ~35M tokens/month during batch runs.
- Target unit economics: your finance team is targeting ~$900 per 1M tokens (all-in) for production. For the pilot you indicated willingness to evaluate $/1M tokens between $700–1,000 depending on latency and quality.
- Success criteria: integration with a 2-step ranking flow, latency under 300ms p50 for single-turn queries, and stability during batch reprocessing jobs.
- Timeline: 4–6 week pilot, with a 30–60 day extension possible if we need more runway for evaluation.

Next steps from Redwood:
1) I'll provision an initial set of pilot credits for you to start integration and load testing.
2) Share a short pilot scope doc and burn-rate checklist (attached).
3) Quick sync next week to agree on telemetry & SLOs we should monitor.

If you can confirm the monthly token expectations and a preferred target $/1M tokens, I can route a credits extension request to our internal approvals today.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

Attachments: pilot_scope_acme.pdf (pilot scope & burn-rate checklist)
From: Lia Chen <lia.chen@acmeanalytics.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@acmeanalytics.com>
Date: Thu, 26 Feb 2026 09:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Follow-up: pilot scope, token volumes & pricing targets

Hi Marissa — thanks for the clear recap. Confirming the numbers from our side: 

- Baseline: 12–18M tokens/month during normal operations.
- Peak/batch: up to 35M tokens during nightly reprocessing we plan to run in week 3 of the pilot.
- Budget & unit economics: our procurement target is ~$900 / 1M tokens for a production contract. For the pilot we’d like to test at an effective rate of ~$700 / 1M tokens if possible, but we understand pilot credits may cover incremental cost.
- Goal: validate latency and throughput for both interactive and batch workloads and confirm model quality for our reranking step.

Request: given the batch spikes, would it be possible to extend the pilot credits to 60 days and provide an additional $5k in credits to cover burst testing? That should get us through the validation window.

Thanks — happy to hop on a 30 min call next Tue to go over telemetry and the burn-rate plan.

— Lia
Lia Chen
Head of Data Products, Acme Analytics
lia.chen@acmeanalytics.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lia Chen <lia.chen@acmeanalytics.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 26 Feb 2026 11:08:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Follow-up: pilot scope, token volumes & pricing targets

Lia — appreciate the clarity. We can support the request. Confirming what I’ll do today: 

- Approve a 60-day pilot extension and add $5,000 in Redwood credits for Acme to cover burst/batch testing. I’ve attached the internal approval note for records.
- I’ve also attached the pilot scope doc with a burn-rate checklist. On the checklist we call out prefix caching, batch window sizing, and KV cache warm-up as key levers to control cost during the nightly reprocessing so you don’t consume credits unnecessarily.
- For pricing conversations post-pilot, I’ll loop Marcus (solutions architect) and Neha (pricing lead) into a follow-up to model your 12–18M baseline and 35M peak. We’ll prepare an illustrative unit-econ workbook showing how batching/caching/quantization profiles impact $/1M tokens under your load profile.

Action items: 
- I’ll provision the credits and share the HubSpot record & Drive folder with the scope docs (links below). Expect an email from finance with the credit allocation number by EOD.
- Can you confirm your preferred time for a Tue 30-min sync? Marcus will join to cover integration questions.

Sincerely,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwoodinference.com

Attachments: credit_approval_note.pdf, pilot_scope_acme.pdf
Related links: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/company/ACME-72 , https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cACME-pilot-scope

Date: Fri, 27 Feb 2026 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pilot credits extension & burn-rate check-in

Perfect — thanks Marissa, that works for us.

We’ll plan the load tests for week 3 and run a dry-run next Wed to validate telemetry. Tue for the sync is ideal; how about Tue 10:00am PT? I’ll send a calendar invite.

Appreciate the quick turnaround on the credits and the burn-rate checklist — that should keep our credit burn focused on validation instead of wasted retries.

Talk soon,
Lia
